gitCommit.subject: refactor: Enhance Data Catalog functionality with Snowflake Explore Navigation
gitCommit.body:
refactor: Enhance Data Catalog functionality with Snowflake Explore Navigation

- Added new constants for Snowflake Explore configuration in dynamicTestConstants.js.
- Implemented detailed navigation methods in DataCatalogPage.js for exploring Snowflake data, including expanding tree nodes and selecting tables.
- Updated tests in data-catalog.spec.js to cover new navigation flows and lineage interactions.
- Commented out existing tests in tableau-to-powerbi.spec.js for future reference.
